headline_hook: OpenAI Ships GPT-5.6 in Three Flavors as Anthropic Bets on Radical Transparency

pick_of_the_day.thesis: Opening a public channel for hard questions is Anthropic's bet that earned trust compounds faster than institutional opacity — treating public scrutiny as a product feature, not a liability, may be the move that separates frontier labs that earn enterprise confidence from those that buy it.

model_literacy.relevance: GPT-5.6 ships as Luna/Terra/Sol — three capability tiers under one version number. The industry is shifting from 'upgrade to the next number' to 'pick the right tier for your task.' Understanding price-performance frontiers across tiers now matters more than chasing the biggest model.

items.title: OpenAI Unveils GPT-5.6: Luna, Terra, and Sol Split the Frontier Into Three Lanes
items.angle: The first tiered model family from OpenAI signals that frontier capability is no longer one-size-fits-all — builders now pick their price-performance lane at the model level
items.key_fact: Three tiers (Luna, Terra, Sol) targeting different cost-capability segments within one model generation

items.title: Claude Gets a Mirror: Monthly Recaps Show How You Actually Use AI
items.angle: The first AI assistant that reflects your usage patterns back to you — Anthropic turns self-awareness into a product feature that no competitor has tried
items.key_fact: Monthly recap includes usage patterns, peak hours, and work style observations with optional focus timers and break reminders

items.title: Meta Opens Muse Spark 1.1 Through Its Model API
items.angle: Meta expands generative media capabilities via API — the walled-garden-to-API pipeline continues as Meta makes its creative AI accessible to developers
items.key_fact: 309 HN upvotes signal strong developer interest in Meta's generative media play

items.title: ChatGPT Work Arrives as OpenAI's Enterprise Play
items.angle: OpenAI's direct answer to Claude Teams/Enterprise positions ChatGPT as the productivity suite for organizations, not just individuals
items.key_fact: 314 HN upvotes — enterprise AI tools now generate consumer-level excitement

items.title: Vercel AI SDK Adds MCP Tool Drift Detection — Your Agents Just Got Tamper-Aware
items.angle: fingerprintTools and detectToolDrift catch schema tampering in MCP servers — critical security infrastructure for anyone running third-party tools in production agents
items.key_fact: New fingerprintTools() and detectToolDrift() APIs detect when MCP tool definitions change unexpectedly between calls

items.title: MCP Server SDK Beta.3 Accepts Zod Schemas in Elicitation
items.angle: The DX gap between MCP server development and the rest of the TypeScript ecosystem just closed — Zod schemas work everywhere now
items.key_fact: inputRequired.elicit() now accepts Zod schemas directly, matching the validation tools developers already use

items.title: OpenAI Python SDK v2.45.0 Ships with GPT-5.6 Sol Support
items.angle: Day-zero SDK support means developers can start integrating the new top-tier model immediately — no waiting for library catch-up
items.key_fact: GPT-5.6 Sol model ID available in openai-python from release day

items.title: OpenAI Node SDK Fixes Silent Streaming Corruption Alongside Sol Support
items.angle: The GPT-5.6 Sol support headline buries the lede — a fix for assistants array delta ordering that was silently corrupting streaming tool calls in production
items.key_fact: Streaming tool call corruption fix: assistants array delta ordering bug silently mangled multi-tool responses

items.title: Anthropic Invites the Hard Questions and Commits to Showing Their Work
items.angle: A frontier lab opening a public channel for uncomfortable questions and pledging to answer them publicly — this is either genuine accountability infrastructure or the most sophisticated trust-building exercise in AI
items.key_fact: Public commitment to answering hard AI questions with published reasoning — no other frontier lab has made this kind of standing offer

items.title: Grok 4.5 Lands as xAI's First Opus-Class Model Post-Cursor Acquisition

items.key_fact: First Opus-class competitor from xAI, contextualized within the Cursor acquisition that merges IDE and model development
